name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-embassy
title: Shin Megami Tensei - Embassy
description:
There‘s a different version of this track with slightly different pitch, panning and a bit more complex drum pattern in SMT if... known as 'School 4–10 F‘.
You can switch between the SMT 1 and SMT if… versions with:
Set define to #define Version 0, to get the SMT 1 version
set define to #define Version 1, to get the SMT if… version
